日夜.gloss: day and night; around the clock

example.zh: 为了按时完成工程，工人们日夜不停地施工。
example.en: To finish the project on time, the workers kept working day and night.

quiz.zh: 母亲日夜守在病床前，人都瘦了一大圈。
quiz.en: Mother kept watch by the sickbed day and night and grew visibly thinner.

流量.gloss: flow volume; traffic (of people or vehicles); mobile data
流量.indonesian: volume aliran; arus (orang atau kendaraan); kuota data internet

example.zh: 这个月的手机流量快用完了，我只能连无线网看视频。
example.en: My phone data for this month is almost used up, so I can only watch videos on Wi-Fi.

quiz.zh: 节假日期间，景区的游客流量比平时增加了三倍。
quiz.en: During the holidays, the flow of visitors to the scenic area was three times higher than usual.

厂商.gloss: manufacturer; firm, vendor (company making or selling goods)
厂商.indonesian: produsen; perusahaan pembuat atau penjual barang

example.zh: 多家手机厂商在展会上发布了最新产品。
example.en: Several phone makers launched their latest products at the trade show.

quiz.zh: 国内外汽车厂商纷纷降价，希望吸引更多消费者。
quiz.en: Car makers at home and abroad have cut prices one after another, hoping to attract more buyers.

example.zh: 刚到高原的人容易出现头疼、呼吸困难等反应。
example.en: People who have just arrived on the plateau often get headaches and have trouble breathing.

quiz.zh: 青藏高原平均海拔四千米以上，被称为“世界屋脊”。
quiz.en: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau averages over 4,000 meters above sea level and is called "the roof of the world".

套餐.gloss: set meal, combo; package (of services, e.g. a phone plan)
套餐.indonesian: paket makanan; paket (layanan, mis. paket ponsel)

example.zh: 这家快餐店的午餐套餐包括一个汉堡、一份薯条和一杯饮料。
example.en: This fast-food restaurant's lunch combo includes a burger, fries and a drink.

quiz.zh: 我换了一个新的手机套餐，每个月的话费便宜了不少。
quiz.en: I switched to a new phone plan and my monthly bill is a lot cheaper.

example.zh: 从这张图表可以看出，今年的销售额明显上升了。
example.en: You can see from this chart that sales have clearly gone up this year.

quiz.zh: 报告里的数据太多了，最好用图表来展示，这样更直观。
quiz.en: There is too much data in the report; it's better to present it in charts so it's easier to grasp.

example.zh: 天气太热了，我一点儿食欲也没有。
example.en: It's so hot that I have no appetite at all.

quiz.zh: 这道菜颜色鲜艳，香味扑鼻，让人食欲大增。
quiz.en: This dish is brightly colored and smells wonderful; it really whets your appetite.

风雨.gloss: wind and rain; trials and hardships
风雨.indonesian: angin dan hujan; cobaan dan kesulitan hidup

example.zh: 外面风雨交加，我们还是改天再去吧。
example.en: It's windy and pouring outside; let's go another day.

quiz.zh: 两人一起经历了几十年的风雨，感情越来越深。
quiz.en: The two of them have weathered decades of ups and downs together, and their bond keeps growing deeper.

example.zh: 景德镇的瓷器在世界上非常有名。
example.en: Porcelain from Jingdezhen is famous all over the world.

quiz.zh: 搬家的时候，这些瓷器要用报纸包好，免得打碎。
quiz.en: When we move, this china needs to be wrapped in newspaper so it doesn't break.

日后.gloss: in the future, later on, some day

example.zh: 这些资料你先留着，日后说不定用得上。
example.en: Hold on to these materials for now; you may need them later.

quiz.zh: 您的帮助我会一直记在心里，日后一定好好报答。
quiz.en: I'll always remember your help, and I'll be sure to repay you some day.

example.zh: 随着人口老龄化，一些地区开始出现劳动力短缺。
example.en: As the population ages, some regions are starting to face labor shortages.

quiz.zh: 机器人的使用大大节省了劳动力，提高了生产效率。
quiz.en: Using robots has saved a great deal of manpower and raised productivity.

分工.gloss: to divide up the work; division of labor

example.zh: 我们四个人分工合作，一个下午就把活儿干完了。
example.en: The four of us split up the work and got it all done in one afternoon.

quiz.zh: 这次活动分工明确，有人负责宣传，有人负责接待。
quiz.en: The roles for this event are clearly divided: some people handle publicity, others handle reception.

率先.gloss: to be the first to; to take the lead in (doing something)

example.zh: 这家公司率先推出了折叠屏手机。
example.en: This company was the first to launch a foldable-screen phone.

quiz.zh: 比赛进行到第十分钟，主队率先打进一球。
quiz.en: Ten minutes into the match, the home team scored the opening goal.

历经.gloss: to go through, to undergo (over a long time)

example.zh: 这座古桥历经数百年风雨，至今依然坚固。
example.en: This ancient bridge has stood through centuries of wind and rain and is still solid today.

quiz.zh: 这项研究历经十年，终于取得了重大突破。
quiz.en: After ten years of work, this research has finally made a major breakthrough.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢看科幻小说，梦想有一天能飞向太空。
example.en: He has loved sci-fi novels since he was little and dreams of flying into space one day.

quiz.zh: 这部科幻电影讲述了人类移民火星的故事。
quiz.en: This science fiction film tells the story of humans settling on Mars.

厂家.gloss: manufacturer; factory (as the maker of a product)

example.zh: 这批产品质量有问题，厂家已经决定全部召回。
example.en: This batch of products has quality problems, and the manufacturer has decided to recall all of it.

quiz.zh: 直接从厂家进货，价格要比从批发商那里便宜得多。
quiz.en: Buying stock directly from the factory is much cheaper than going through a wholesaler.

example.zh: 中国跳水队在这次比赛中获得了好几枚金牌。
example.en: The Chinese diving team won several gold medals at this competition.

quiz.zh: 他站在十米高的跳台上，深吸一口气，完成了一个漂亮的跳水动作。
quiz.en: Standing on the ten-meter platform, he took a deep breath and performed a beautiful dive.

推行.gloss: to carry out, to implement, to promote (a policy or practice)

example.zh: 学校推行垃圾分类以后，校园变得干净多了。
example.en: Since the school introduced garbage sorting, the campus has become much cleaner.

quiz.zh: 这项新政策先在几个城市试点，然后再在全国推行。
quiz.en: The new policy will be piloted in a few cities first and then rolled out nationwide.

example.zh: 我等了你一个多钟头，你怎么才来？
example.en: I've been waiting for you for over an hour. Why are you only getting here now?

quiz.zh: 从这儿开车去机场，不堵车的话两个钟头就到了。
quiz.en: If there's no traffic, it takes two hours to drive from here to the airport.

example.zh: 周末他常和朋友去俱乐部打台球。
example.en: On weekends he often goes to the club to play pool with friends.

quiz.zh: 他一杆把桌上的台球全打进了洞，大家都看呆了。
quiz.en: He potted every ball on the table in a single turn, and everyone stared in amazement.

互助.gloss: to help each other; mutual aid

example.zh: 这个小区的邻居们互助互爱，谁家有困难大家都会帮一把。
example.en: The neighbors in this community look out for each other; whenever a family has trouble, everyone lends a hand.

quiz.zh: 同学们成立了学习互助小组，成绩好的帮助成绩差的。
quiz.en: The students set up a study support group in which the stronger students help the weaker ones.

解说.gloss: to explain orally, to narrate; to commentate

example.zh: 导游一边走一边为我们解说这座古城的历史。
example.en: As we walked, the guide explained the history of the old town to us.

quiz.zh: 这场足球比赛由一位著名的体育评论员现场解说。
quiz.en: A well-known sports commentator provided live commentary for this soccer match.

淹.gloss: to flood, to submerge; to drown

example.zh: 一场大雨过后，路边的农田都被淹了。
example.en: After a heavy rainstorm, the fields along the road were all flooded.

quiz.zh: 这条街一下大雨就会被淹，车根本开不过去。
quiz.en: This street floods every time it rains hard, and cars can't get through at all.

example.zh: 孩子发烧了，我们赶紧带他去医院儿科看病。
example.en: Our child had a fever, so we hurried him to the hospital's pediatrics department.

quiz.zh: 她是一名儿科医生，每天要给几十个小朋友看病。
quiz.en: She's a pediatrician and sees dozens of children every day.

example.zh: 请不要把贵重物品放在车里。
example.en: Please don't leave valuables in the car.

quiz.zh: 这份礼物太贵重了，我真的不能收。
quiz.en: This gift is too valuable; I really can't accept it.

动听.gloss: pleasant to listen to, melodious; (of words) persuasive

example.zh: 她的歌声非常动听，让人百听不厌。
example.en: Her singing is so lovely that you never get tired of hearing it.

quiz.zh: 他说得再动听，我也不会相信他了。
quiz.en: No matter how nice he makes it sound, I won't believe him anymore.

example.zh: 祝您老人家健康长寿，生日快乐！
example.en: Happy birthday! Wishing you good health and a long life.

quiz.zh: 这个村子里的老人大多很长寿，九十岁以上的就有二十多位。
quiz.en: Most of the elderly in this village live long lives; more than twenty are over ninety.

example.zh: 雪地上留下了一串小狗的脚印。
example.en: A trail of puppy footprints was left in the snow.

quiz.zh: 警察在窗户下面发现了几个可疑的脚印。
quiz.en: The police found several suspicious footprints under the window.

流入.gloss: to flow into; to pour into (of money, people)

example.zh: 这条河自西向东，最后流入大海。
example.en: This river runs from west to east and finally flows into the sea.

quiz.zh: 大量外资流入国内市场，带动了经济增长。
quiz.en: Large amounts of foreign capital flowed into the domestic market and drove economic growth.

example.zh: 做生意一定要讲诚信，不能欺骗顾客。
example.en: In business you must be honest and never cheat your customers.

quiz.zh: 一个人如果失去了诚信，就很难再得到别人的信任。
quiz.en: Once a person loses their integrity, it's very hard to win back other people's trust.

海面.gloss: sea surface, surface of the sea

example.zh: 太阳慢慢从海面上升起来了。
example.en: The sun slowly rose from the surface of the sea.

quiz.zh: 风停了，海面平静得像一面镜子。
quiz.en: The wind died down, and the sea was as calm as a mirror.

example.zh: 中国队在本届奥运会上一共获得了八十多枚奖牌。
example.en: The Chinese team won more than eighty medals in total at this Olympics.

quiz.zh: 比赛结束后，运动员们高高举起奖牌，向观众挥手致意。
quiz.en: After the competition, the athletes held their medals high and waved to the crowd.

example.zh: 工地的噪声太大了，晚上根本睡不着。
example.en: The noise from the construction site is so loud that I can't sleep at night.

quiz.zh: 长期生活在噪声环境中，人的听力会受到损害。
quiz.en: Living in a noisy environment for a long time can damage your hearing.

example.zh: 你的话费余额不足，请及时充值。
example.en: Your phone credit balance is low; please top up soon.

quiz.zh: 我查了一下银行卡，发现余额只剩下两百块了。
quiz.en: I checked my bank card and found the balance was down to just two hundred yuan.

example.zh: 他一边找钥匙，一边自言自语：“到底放哪儿了？”
example.en: While looking for his keys, he muttered to himself, "Where on earth did I put them?"

quiz.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，常常一个人坐在窗前自言自语。
quiz.en: Grandma is getting old and often sits alone by the window talking to herself.

example.zh: 山坡上开满了五颜六色的野花。
example.en: The hillside is covered in colorful wildflowers.

quiz.zh: 几头牛在山坡上悠闲地吃着草。
quiz.en: A few cows were grazing leisurely on the slope.

只顾.gloss: to be absorbed only in; to care only about

example.zh: 他只顾着玩手机，连饭都忘了吃。
example.en: He was so absorbed in his phone that he even forgot to eat.

quiz.zh: 做父母的不能只顾工作，也要多陪陪孩子。
quiz.en: Parents can't just focus on work; they also need to spend time with their kids.

定价.gloss: to set a price; fixed or list price

example.zh: 这本书定价五十元，网上买可以打八折。
example.en: This book is priced at fifty yuan, but you can get it 20% off online.

quiz.zh: 新产品该怎么定价，公司还在讨论中。
quiz.en: The company is still discussing how to price the new product.

example.zh: 这位老艺人的剪纸技艺是祖上传下来的，已经传了五代。
example.en: This old artist's paper-cutting craft was handed down from his ancestors and has passed through five generations.

quiz.zh: 这位杂技演员技艺高超，观众们掌声不断。
quiz.en: This acrobat is so highly skilled that the audience kept applauding.

专科.gloss: specialized field (of study or medicine); specialty; junior college
专科.indonesian: bidang spesialis; spesialisasi; sekolah tinggi diploma

example.zh: 她高中毕业后考上了一所医学专科学校。
example.en: After high school she got into a medical college.

quiz.zh: 这是一家眼科专科医院，治疗近视很有经验。
quiz.en: This is a specialist eye hospital with a lot of experience treating nearsightedness.

example.zh: 公安机关已经对这起案件立案调查。
example.en: The public security authorities have opened an investigation into the case.

quiz.zh: 他毕业后当了一名公安干警，负责维护社会治安。
quiz.en: After graduating he became a police officer, responsible for keeping public order.

招生.gloss: to enroll new students, to recruit students

example.zh: 这所大学今年计划招生五千人。
example.en: This university plans to admit five thousand students this year.

quiz.zh: 暑假前，各个培训机构纷纷打出了招生广告。
quiz.en: Before the summer holidays, training schools everywhere put out ads to recruit students.

出游.gloss: to go on a trip, to go traveling

example.zh: 国庆长假期间，全国出游人数超过了四亿。
example.en: During the National Day holiday, more than 400 million people across the country went on trips.

quiz.zh: 天气暖和了，正是全家出游的好时候。
quiz.en: Now that it's warmer, it's the perfect time for a family outing.

example.zh: 适度运动对身体有好处，但不要过量。
example.en: Moderate exercise is good for you, but don't overdo it.

quiz.zh: 孩子玩游戏要适度，不能一玩就是一整天。
quiz.en: Kids should play games in moderation, not for a whole day at a time.

定时.gloss: to set a time (for); at fixed times, regularly; timer
定时.indonesian: mengatur waktu; pada waktu yang tetap, teratur; pengatur waktu

example.zh: 医生让他每天定时吃药，不能随便停。
example.en: The doctor told him to take his medicine at set times every day and not to stop on his own.

quiz.zh: 我给空调设了定时，两个小时以后它会自动关掉。
quiz.en: I set the timer on the air conditioner, so it will switch off automatically in two hours.

减压.gloss: to reduce pressure; to relieve stress

example.zh: 听音乐是一种很好的减压方式。
example.en: Listening to music is a great way to relieve stress.

quiz.zh: 工作压力大的时候，他就去健身房跑步减压。
quiz.en: When work gets stressful, he goes to the gym and runs to unwind.

入门.gloss: to get started, to learn the basics; introduction, primer
入门.indonesian: mulai belajar dasar-dasar; pengantar, tingkat pemula

example.zh: 这本书是编程入门的好教材，很适合初学者。
example.en: This book is a good introduction to programming and well suited to beginners.

quiz.zh: 学书法入门不难，但要写好就得下苦功了。
quiz.en: Getting started with calligraphy isn't hard, but writing well takes a lot of hard work.

example.zh: 近年来，中国的高铁事业飞速发展。
example.en: In recent years, China's high-speed rail has developed at a tremendous pace.

quiz.zh: 一辆摩托车从我身边飞速驶过。
quiz.en: A motorcycle sped past me.

贴近.gloss: to press close to; to be close to (life, reality); intimate

example.zh: 这部电视剧很贴近生活，所以受到观众喜欢。
example.en: This TV series is very true to life, which is why audiences like it.

quiz.zh: 他把耳朵贴近门，想听听里面的人在说什么。
quiz.en: He put his ear close to the door, trying to hear what the people inside were saying.

简介.gloss: brief introduction, synopsis, profile; to introduce briefly
简介.indonesian: pengantar singkat, ringkasan, profil; memperkenalkan secara singkat

example.zh: 请在报名表上写一段个人简介，不超过两百字。
example.en: Please write a short personal profile on the application form, no more than two hundred characters.

quiz.zh: 买书之前，我习惯先看看封底的内容简介。
quiz.en: Before buying a book, I usually read the synopsis on the back cover.

example.zh: 医生说他的喉咙有炎症，需要吃几天消炎药。
example.en: The doctor said his throat was inflamed and he needed to take anti-inflammatory medicine for a few days.

quiz.zh: 伤口没有及时处理，结果引起了炎症。
quiz.en: The wound wasn't treated in time and became inflamed.

example.zh: 这些古建筑是前人留给后人的宝贵财富。
example.en: These ancient buildings are a precious legacy left by our ancestors to later generations.

quiz.zh: 他的发明造福了后人，至今仍被人们怀念。
quiz.en: His invention benefited later generations, and he is still remembered today.

转交.gloss: to pass on, to forward (to someone else)

example.zh: 麻烦你把这封信转交给王老师。
example.en: Could you please pass this letter on to Mr. Wang?

quiz.zh: 李经理今天不在，你的材料我会替你转交。
quiz.en: Manager Li isn't in today; I'll pass your documents on to him for you.

example.zh: 考古学家在这里发现了一处五千年前的村落遗址。
example.en: Archaeologists found the site of a 5,000-year-old village here.

quiz.zh: 圆明园遗址公园每年都吸引大量游客前来参观。
quiz.en: The Old Summer Palace Ruins Park attracts large numbers of visitors every year.

其间.gloss: in the meantime, during that period; among them
其间.indonesian: selama itu, di sela-sela waktu itu; di antaranya

example.zh: 他在国外生活了十年，其间换过好几份工作。
example.en: He lived abroad for ten years and changed jobs several times during that period.

quiz.zh: 从提交申请到正式批准用了三个月，其间我又补交了两次材料。
quiz.en: It took three months from applying to official approval, and in the meantime I had to submit extra documents twice.

example.zh: 这家店的新款连衣裙今天开始打折。
example.en: This store's new-season dresses go on sale starting today.

quiz.zh: 这是我们公司今年推出的新款手机，功能比旧款强多了。
quiz.en: This is the new phone model our company launched this year; it's much more capable than the old one.

内外.gloss: inside and outside; domestic and foreign
内外.indonesian: dalam dan luar; dalam dan luar negeri

example.zh: 车站内外挤满了回家过年的人。
example.en: Inside and outside the station, it was packed with people going home for the New Year.

quiz.zh: 为了迎接检查，大家把校园内外打扫得干干净净。
quiz.en: To get ready for the inspection, everyone cleaned the campus inside and out.

example.zh: 大城市的房价太高，很多年轻人买不起房子。
example.en: Housing prices in big cities are so high that many young people can't afford a home.

quiz.zh: 最近几个月，这个城市的房价一直在下跌。
quiz.en: Property prices in this city have kept falling over the past few months.

报刊.indonesian: surat kabar dan majalah, media cetak

example.zh: 图书馆的阅览室里有各种各样的报刊。
example.en: The library reading room has all kinds of newspapers and magazines.

quiz.zh: 他退休后常给一些报刊写文章。
quiz.en: After retiring, he often writes articles for newspapers and magazines.

example.zh: 这本词典已经修订过三次了。
example.en: This dictionary has been revised three times.

quiz.zh: 公司正在修订员工手册，增加了一些新规定。
quiz.en: The company is revising the employee handbook and adding some new rules.

example.zh: 他在马路边招手，拦下了一辆出租车。
example.en: He waved from the roadside and flagged down a taxi.

quiz.zh: 看到我进门，她笑着向我招手，让我坐到她旁边。
quiz.en: When she saw me come in, she smiled and beckoned me to sit next to her.

只得.gloss: to have no choice but to, can only

example.zh: 末班车已经开走了，我们只得打车回家。
example.en: The last bus had already left, so we had no choice but to take a taxi home.

quiz.zh: 外面下起了大雨，运动会只得推迟到下周举行。
quiz.en: It started pouring, so the sports meet had to be postponed to next week.

example.zh: 这家公司优化了网站设计，用户体验好多了。
example.en: The company optimized its website design, and the user experience is much better.

quiz.zh: 政府不断优化营商环境，吸引了更多企业投资。
quiz.en: The government keeps improving the business environment, attracting more companies to invest.

传承.gloss: to pass on and carry forward (a tradition); heritage

example.zh: 传统手艺需要年轻人来传承。
example.en: Traditional crafts need young people to carry them on.

quiz.zh: 这家老字号已经传承了一百多年，味道一直没变。
quiz.en: This time-honored shop has been handed down for over a hundred years, and its flavor has never changed.

example.zh: 现在很多教室都安装了多媒体设备。
example.en: Many classrooms now have multimedia equipment installed.

quiz.zh: 老师用多媒体课件上课，学生们听得特别认真。
quiz.en: The teacher used multimedia slides in class, and the students listened especially closely.

example.zh: 这篇稿子明天就要交，我今晚得加班改完。
example.en: This piece is due tomorrow, so I have to work late tonight to finish revising it.

quiz.zh: 他上台演讲时太紧张，忘了带稿子，只好临场发挥。
quiz.en: He was so nervous going on stage that he forgot his script and had to improvise.

example.zh: 妈妈每天早上给孩子冲一瓶奶粉。
example.en: Every morning, Mom makes the baby a bottle of formula.

quiz.zh: 这家超市的进口奶粉正在打折，很多年轻父母都来抢购。
quiz.en: Imported formula is on sale at this supermarket, and lots of young parents are rushing to buy it.

example.zh: 这个行李箱的一个轮子坏了，拉起来很费劲。
example.en: One of this suitcase's wheels is broken, so it's hard to pull.

quiz.zh: 这辆玩具车少了一个轮子，跑不起来了。
quiz.en: This toy car is missing a wheel and won't run.

example.zh: 您老人家今年多大岁数了？身体还这么硬朗！
example.en: How old are you this year, sir? You're still in such good shape!

quiz.zh: 爷爷岁数大了，耳朵有点儿背，你说话大声点儿。
quiz.en: Grandpa is getting on in years and is a bit hard of hearing, so speak up.

example.zh: 周末我们开车去郊外野餐吧。
example.en: Let's drive out to the countryside for a picnic this weekend.

quiz.zh: 城里太吵了，他退休后搬到郊外住了。
quiz.en: The city was too noisy, so after retiring he moved out to the outskirts.

example.zh: 南方的空气湿度大，衣服很难晾干。
example.en: The air in the south is so humid that clothes take forever to dry.

quiz.zh: 这种植物喜欢温暖的环境，对空气湿度的要求也比较高。
quiz.en: This plant likes warm conditions and also needs fairly high humidity.

example.zh: 今年冬天比往年冷得多，河面都结冰了。
example.en: This winter is much colder than in previous years; even the river has frozen over.

quiz.zh: 跟往年相比，今年报考研究生的人数又增加了。
quiz.en: Compared with past years, the number of people applying for graduate school has gone up again this year.

example.zh: 这种节能灯比普通灯泡省电多了。
example.en: This energy-saving lamp uses much less electricity than an ordinary bulb.

quiz.zh: 夏天把空调温度调到二十六度，既舒服又节能。
quiz.en: In summer, setting the AC to 26 degrees is both comfortable and saves energy.

example.zh: 地铁开通以后，市民出行变得更加便捷了。
example.en: Since the subway opened, getting around the city has become much more convenient.

quiz.zh: 手机支付既安全又便捷，现在很多人出门都不带现金了。
quiz.en: Mobile payment is safe and convenient, so many people no longer carry cash when they go out.

用人.gloss: to employ people, to choose and use staff
用人.indonesian: mempekerjakan orang, memilih dan menggunakan tenaga kerja

example.zh: 这家公司用人只看能力，不看学历。
example.en: When hiring, this company looks only at ability, not at degrees.

quiz.zh: 最近店里生意特别好，正是用人的时候。
quiz.en: Business at the shop has been booming lately, so it's exactly when we need more hands.

example.zh: 他家里条件不好，十五岁就不念书了，出去打工。
example.en: His family was poor, so he left school at fifteen to go out and work.

quiz.zh: 我妹妹在北京念书，每年只有寒暑假才回家。
quiz.en: My younger sister is at school in Beijing and only comes home during the winter and summer breaks.

理科.gloss: science (as a school track or subjects); the sciences

example.zh: 他理科成绩很好，尤其是数学和物理。
example.en: He does very well in the science subjects, especially math and physics.

quiz.zh: 高二分科的时候，她选了理科，因为她想当工程师。
quiz.en: When students chose their tracks in the second year of high school, she picked sciences because she wants to be an engineer.

example.zh: 把箱子用胶带封好，再写上地址。
example.en: Seal the box with tape and then write the address on it.

quiz.zh: 海报掉下来了，你帮我用胶带把它重新贴上吧。
quiz.en: The poster fell down; could you help me stick it back up with tape?

example.zh: 他们家的房子有一百二十平方米。
example.en: Their apartment is 120 square meters.

quiz.zh: 这个广场占地两万平方米，可以同时容纳上万人。
quiz.en: The square covers 20,000 square meters and can hold over ten thousand people at once.

example.zh: 图书馆的书按类别摆放，找起来很方便。
example.en: The library's books are shelved by category, so they're easy to find.

quiz.zh: 垃圾分为四个类别，请大家按要求投放。
quiz.en: Garbage is divided into four categories; please dispose of it accordingly.

联网.gloss: to connect to the internet or a network; to be online
联网.indonesian: terhubung ke internet atau jaringan; daring

example.zh: 这款游戏必须联网才能玩，没有网络就打不开。
example.en: This game has to be online to play; without a connection it won't even open.

quiz.zh: 现在很多家电都可以联网，用手机就能远程控制。
quiz.en: Many home appliances can now go online and be controlled remotely from your phone.

example.zh: 每天有十几班客车从县城开往省城。
example.en: More than a dozen buses run from the county town to the provincial capital every day.

quiz.zh: 一辆载有三十名乘客的客车在高速公路上发生了事故。
quiz.en: A coach carrying thirty passengers had an accident on the highway.

example.zh: 下完棋后，请把棋子收回盒子里。
example.en: After the game, please put the pieces back in the box.

quiz.zh: 孩子把棋子撒了一地，我们找了半天才找齐。
quiz.en: The kid scattered the pieces all over the floor, and it took us ages to find them all.

求职.gloss: to look for a job, to apply for jobs

example.zh: 毕业季到了，很多大学生忙着求职。
example.en: Graduation season is here, and many college students are busy job hunting.

quiz.zh: 他在求职网站上投了几十份简历，终于收到了面试通知。
quiz.en: He sent out dozens of résumés on job sites and finally got an interview.

example.zh: 升国旗的时候，全体师生一起唱国歌。
example.en: During the flag-raising ceremony, all the teachers and students sang the national anthem together.

quiz.zh: 运动员站上领奖台，听到国歌响起，激动得流下了眼泪。
quiz.en: Standing on the podium and hearing the national anthem play, the athlete was moved to tears.

倒车.gloss: to reverse (a vehicle), to back up

example.zh: 倒车的时候要注意看后视镜。
example.en: Keep an eye on the mirrors when you're reversing.

quiz.zh: 停车场太窄，他倒车的时候不小心撞到了柱子。
quiz.en: The parking lot was so tight that he accidentally hit a pillar while backing up.

风力.gloss: wind force, wind strength; wind power

example.zh: 预计明天风力将达到六到七级。
example.en: Winds tomorrow are expected to reach force six to seven.

quiz.zh: 这个地区建了很多风力发电站，为城市提供清洁能源。
quiz.en: Many wind power stations have been built in this region, supplying the city with clean energy.

example.zh: 音乐会上，乐队演奏了几首著名的乐曲。
example.en: At the concert, the orchestra played several famous pieces.

quiz.zh: 这首乐曲旋律优美，听了让人心情放松。
quiz.en: This piece has a beautiful melody that puts you at ease.

example.zh: 婚宴的酒水由我们自己准备。
example.en: We're providing the drinks for the wedding banquet ourselves.

quiz.zh: 这家饭店规定，客人不能自带酒水。
quiz.en: This restaurant doesn't allow guests to bring their own drinks.

example.zh: 人工智能是一个新兴产业，发展前景很好。
example.en: Artificial intelligence is an emerging industry with excellent prospects.

quiz.zh: 随着互联网的普及，出现了很多新兴职业，比如网络主播。
quiz.en: With the spread of the internet, many new professions have emerged, such as online streamers.

example.zh: 地震发生后，灾区最缺的是食物和饮用水。
example.en: After the earthquake, what the disaster area needed most was food and drinking water.

quiz.zh: 出门爬山一定要带足饮用水，山上没有卖水的地方。
quiz.en: Be sure to bring enough drinking water when you go hiking; there's nowhere to buy water on the mountain.

example.zh: 公司年终给每位员工发了一笔奖金。
example.en: At the end of the year, the company gave every employee a bonus.

quiz.zh: 快到年底了，各部门都在忙着写年终总结。
quiz.en: The year is nearly over, and every department is busy writing its year-end review.

汇款.gloss: to remit money, to transfer money; remittance

example.zh: 他每个月都给老家的父母汇款。
example.en: Every month he sends money to his parents back home.

quiz.zh: 收到汇款以后，我们会尽快给您发货。
quiz.en: Once we receive your payment, we'll ship your order as soon as possible.

example.zh: 很多农民通过网络直播销售自家的农产品。
example.en: Many farmers sell their own produce through online livestreams.

quiz.zh: 这个县的农产品质量好，远销全国各地。
quiz.en: This county's farm products are of high quality and are sold all over the country.

example.zh: 这支钢笔是爷爷送给我的生日礼物。
example.en: This fountain pen was a birthday present from my grandpa.

quiz.zh: 练字的时候，老师要求我们用钢笔，不能用圆珠笔。
quiz.en: For handwriting practice, the teacher makes us use fountain pens, not ballpoints.

example.zh: 现在国产手机的质量越来越好了。
example.en: Domestically made phones keep getting better.

quiz.zh: 这部国产电影上映三天，票房就突破了十亿元。
quiz.en: This Chinese-made film took in over a billion yuan at the box office within three days of release.

example.zh: 热水器坏了，今天只能洗冷水澡了。
example.en: The water heater is broken, so I'll have to take a cold shower today.

quiz.zh: 洗澡前记得先打开热水器，等水热了再洗。
quiz.en: Remember to turn on the water heater before your shower and wait until the water's hot.

常年.gloss: all year round; for many years

example.zh: 这座山的山顶常年积雪，盛夏也不融化。
example.en: The summit of this mountain is snow-capped all year round; the snow doesn't melt even in midsummer.

quiz.zh: 他常年在外地工作，一年只回家一两次。
quiz.en: He has worked away from home for years and only goes back once or twice a year.

example.zh: 远处的山峰被白云遮住了，只露出一个尖顶。
example.en: The distant peak was hidden by white clouds, with only its tip showing.

quiz.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山峰。
quiz.en: Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world.

example.zh: 这次改革涉及社会的方方面面。
example.en: This reform touches every aspect of society.

quiz.zh: 开公司要考虑的事情很多，方方面面都得想到。
quiz.en: There's a lot to consider when starting a company; you have to think of everything.

example.zh: 每天坚持散步对健康大有益处。
example.en: Walking every day is very good for your health.

quiz.zh: 多读书的益处很多，它能让人开阔眼界。
quiz.en: Reading a lot has many benefits; it broadens your horizons.

下功夫.gloss: to put in effort, to work hard at

example.zh: 要想学好汉语，就得在听说上多下功夫。
example.en: If you want to learn Chinese well, you need to put a lot of effort into listening and speaking.

quiz.zh: 只要肯下功夫，没有学不会的东西。
quiz.en: As long as you're willing to work hard, there's nothing you can't learn.

example.zh: 这首民歌在当地流传了几百年。
example.en: This folk song has been passed down locally for hundreds of years.

quiz.zh: 晚会上，她用家乡话唱了一首民歌，赢得了热烈的掌声。
quiz.en: At the party, she sang a folk song in her hometown dialect and won warm applause.

example.zh: 这位科学家经常在网上做科普，深受年轻人喜欢。
example.en: This scientist often explains science online and is very popular with young people.

quiz.zh: 博物馆为孩子们举办了一场天文科普讲座。
quiz.en: The museum held a popular-science talk on astronomy for children.

example.zh: 秋天到了，公园里落叶遍地，踩上去沙沙响。
example.en: Autumn has come; fallen leaves cover the park and rustle underfoot.

quiz.zh: 春天的草原上遍地都是野花。
quiz.en: In spring the grassland is covered with wildflowers.

example.zh: 这家电视台有一个专门的少儿频道。
example.en: This TV station has a dedicated children's channel.

quiz.zh: 暑假期间，图书馆为少儿读者推出了很多活动。
quiz.en: During the summer holidays, the library put on many activities for young readers.

example.zh: 出发前最好先在手机上查一下路况。
example.en: It's best to check traffic conditions on your phone before setting off.

quiz.zh: 下雪天路况不好，开车一定要慢一点儿。
quiz.en: Road conditions are bad when it snows, so be sure to drive slowly.

example.zh: 这条路禁止机动车通行，只能步行或骑自行车。
example.en: Motor vehicles are banned on this road; you can only walk or cycle.

quiz.zh: 近年来，城市里的机动车数量增长很快，交通越来越拥挤。
quiz.en: In recent years the number of motor vehicles in the city has grown fast, and traffic is getting more and more congested.

example.zh: 由于原材料涨价，这家工厂的产品也跟着涨价了。
example.en: Because raw materials went up in price, this factory's products got more expensive too.

quiz.zh: 这个地区盛产木材，为家具厂提供了丰富的原材料。
quiz.en: This region produces a lot of timber, giving furniture factories plenty of raw material.

从业.gloss: to work in (a profession or trade)

example.zh: 他在金融行业从业二十多年，经验非常丰富。
example.en: He has worked in finance for over twenty years and is very experienced.

quiz.zh: 从业人员必须持证上岗，这是行业的基本要求。
quiz.en: Practitioners must be licensed before they start work; that's a basic requirement of the industry.

总计.gloss: to total, to add up to; in total

example.zh: 这次活动总计有三千多人参加。
example.en: In total, more than three thousand people took part in the event.

quiz.zh: 把各项费用加在一起，总计花了一万两千元。
quiz.en: Adding up all the expenses, we spent twelve thousand yuan in total.

example.zh: 这座体育场规模宏大，可以容纳十万名观众。
example.en: This stadium is enormous and can seat a hundred thousand spectators.

quiz.zh: 电影开头的战争场面非常宏大，看得人热血沸腾。
quiz.en: The battle scene at the start of the film is so epic that it gets your blood pumping.

example.zh: 梅花在寒冷的冬天开放，象征着坚强。
example.en: Plum blossoms bloom in the cold of winter and symbolize resilience.

quiz.zh: 下了一夜雪，院子里的梅花在白雪的映衬下显得更红了。
quiz.en: After a night of snow, the plum blossoms in the courtyard looked even redder against the white.

example.zh: 他从小就近视，一直戴着眼镜。
example.en: He has been nearsighted since childhood and has always worn glasses.

quiz.zh: 长时间玩手机容易导致近视，要注意保护眼睛。
quiz.en: Spending long hours on your phone can lead to nearsightedness, so take care of your eyes.

example.zh: 地震发生后，全国各地的救援物资源源不断地运往灾区。
example.en: After the earthquake, relief supplies poured into the disaster area from all over the country.

quiz.zh: 大批医护人员赶到灾区，为受伤群众治疗。
quiz.en: Large numbers of medical staff rushed to the stricken area to treat the injured.

example.zh: 他做事太马虎，作业里总有错别字。
example.en: He's so careless that his homework is always full of wrong characters.

quiz.zh: 这可是关系到病人生命的事，一点儿也马虎不得。
quiz.en: This concerns a patient's life, so there's no room for any carelessness.

example.zh: 汉语里一个汉字一般代表一个音节。
example.en: In Chinese, one character usually stands for one syllable.

quiz.zh: “老师”这个词有两个音节，第二个是第一声。
quiz.en: The word "laoshi" has two syllables, and the second one is in the first tone.

example.zh: 车门打开后，乘客们排着队有序地上了车。
example.en: When the doors opened, the passengers lined up and boarded in an orderly way.

quiz.zh: 虽然现场来了上千人，但一切都进行得井然有序。
quiz.en: Even though over a thousand people showed up, everything went smoothly and in good order.

受灾.gloss: to be hit by a disaster

example.zh: 这次洪水使十几个县受灾，上万人无家可归。
example.en: The flood hit more than a dozen counties and left tens of thousands of people homeless.

quiz.zh: 政府及时向受灾群众发放了食物和帐篷。
quiz.en: The government promptly handed out food and tents to the people affected by the disaster.

example.zh: 这家餐厅人均消费大约一百元。
example.en: This restaurant costs about a hundred yuan per person.

quiz.zh: 这个国家的人均收入在过去十年里翻了一番。
quiz.en: This country's per capita income has doubled over the past ten years.

example.zh: 她在女子一百米比赛中获得了银牌。
example.en: She won the silver medal in the women's 100 meters.

quiz.zh: 只差零点一秒就能拿金牌了，最后他只得到了一枚银牌。
quiz.en: He was just a tenth of a second short of gold and ended up with silver.

养老院.gloss: nursing home, home for the elderly

example.zh: 周末，志愿者们到养老院陪老人聊天。
example.en: On weekends, volunteers go to the nursing home to chat with the elderly residents.

quiz.zh: 子女工作太忙，只好把老人送进了养老院。
quiz.en: The children were too busy with work, so they had to put their elderly parent in a care home.

古迹.gloss: historic site, place of historic interest

example.zh: 西安有很多名胜古迹，每年吸引大量游客。
example.en: Xi'an has many famous historic sites that attract huge numbers of tourists every year.

quiz.zh: 保护古迹是每个人的责任，请不要在墙上乱写乱画。
quiz.en: Protecting historic sites is everyone's responsibility; please don't write or draw on the walls.

example.zh: 这节课的难点是如何区分这两个语法点。
example.en: The hard part of this lesson is telling these two grammar points apart.

quiz.zh: 老师把考试中的重点和难点都给我们讲清楚了。
quiz.en: The teacher clearly explained the key points and the tricky parts of the exam to us.

example.zh: 买水果的时候，我会注意看一下产地。
example.en: When I buy fruit, I check where it was grown.

quiz.zh: 新疆是中国有名的哈密瓜产地。
quiz.en: Xinjiang is China's best-known region for growing Hami melons.

补习.gloss: to take extra lessons, to have tutoring (outside regular school)

example.zh: 他数学成绩不好，周末要去补习班补习。
example.en: His math grades are poor, so he goes to a cram school for extra lessons on weekends.

quiz.zh: 为了考上好大学，很多高中生假期都在参加补习。
quiz.en: To get into a good university, many high school students spend their holidays in tutoring classes.

example.zh: 大熊猫是中国的国宝，深受世界各地人们的喜爱。
example.en: The giant panda is China's national treasure and is loved by people all over the world.

quiz.zh: 这件青铜器是博物馆的镇馆之宝，被称为国宝级文物。
quiz.en: This bronze is the museum's prize piece and is considered a relic of national-treasure status.

研讨.gloss: to discuss and study, to deliberate (in depth)

example.zh: 来自各国的专家聚在一起研讨环境保护问题。
example.en: Experts from many countries gathered to discuss environmental protection.

quiz.zh: 下周学院将举办一场关于人工智能的学术研讨会。
quiz.en: Next week the school will hold an academic seminar on artificial intelligence.

两岸.gloss: both banks (of a river); both sides (of a strait)

example.zh: 河的两岸种满了柳树，春天的时候特别美。
example.en: Willows line both banks of the river, and it's especially beautiful in spring.

quiz.zh: 长江两岸灯火通明，夜景非常美。
quiz.en: Both banks of the Yangtze are brightly lit, and the night view is gorgeous.

补课.gloss: to make up a missed lesson; to give or take make-up classes
补课.indonesian: mengganti pelajaran yang tertinggal; kelas tambahan

example.zh: 他生病请了一周假，老师抽时间给他补课。
example.en: He was off sick for a week, so the teacher found time to help him catch up on the lessons.

quiz.zh: 因为台风停课两天，学校决定周六补课。
quiz.en: Classes were cancelled for two days because of the typhoon, so the school decided to hold make-up classes on Saturday.

保修.gloss: to guarantee free repair; to be under warranty

example.zh: 这台电脑保修三年，坏了可以免费修。
example.en: This computer has a three-year warranty, so it can be repaired for free if it breaks.

quiz.zh: 手机还在保修期内，你直接拿到售后服务中心去吧。
quiz.en: Your phone is still under warranty; just take it to the service center.

example.zh: 我姐姐下个月结婚，家里要办喜事了。
example.en: My older sister is getting married next month, so there's a happy celebration coming up in our family.

quiz.zh: 看你笑得这么开心，是不是有什么喜事？
quiz.en: You're smiling so much; has something good happened?

example.zh: 我一坐长途汽车就晕车，所以每次都提前吃药。
example.en: I get carsick whenever I take a long-distance bus, so I always take medicine beforehand.

quiz.zh: 山路弯弯曲曲的，好几个同学都晕车吐了。
quiz.en: The mountain road was so winding that several classmates got carsick and threw up.

日前.indonesian: beberapa hari yang lalu, baru-baru ini

example.zh: 日前，市政府公布了新的交通管理办法。
example.en: A few days ago, the city government announced new traffic management rules.

quiz.zh: 该公司日前宣布，将在明年推出一款新能源汽车。
quiz.en: The company announced recently that it will launch a new-energy vehicle next year.

相传.gloss: according to legend; to hand down (from one to another)

example.zh: 相传这座桥是一位神仙一夜之间造好的。
example.en: Legend has it that this bridge was built overnight by an immortal.

quiz.zh: 这种手艺在当地代代相传，已经有几百年的历史了。
quiz.en: This craft has been passed down locally from generation to generation for several hundred years.

example.zh: 你知道端午节吃粽子这个习俗的由来吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of the custom of eating zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival?

quiz.zh: 这个地名的由来跟一个古老的传说有关。
quiz.en: The origin of this place name is tied to an ancient legend.

example.zh: 楼道里的灯坏了，晚上上楼要小心。
example.en: The light in the stairwell is broken, so be careful going upstairs at night.

quiz.zh: 请不要在楼道里堆放杂物，以免影响通行。
quiz.en: Please don't pile things in the hallway; they get in people's way.

绿化.gloss: to make green (by planting trees and grass); greening

example.zh: 这几年城市绿化做得很好，到处都是绿树和草地。
example.en: The city's greening efforts have gone well these past few years; there are trees and lawns everywhere.

quiz.zh: 为了绿化荒山，村民们每年春天都上山种树。
quiz.en: To green the barren hills, the villagers go up and plant trees every spring.

example.zh: 这条裤子长短正合适，就是腰有点儿肥。
example.en: These trousers are just the right length, but they're a bit loose at the waist.

quiz.zh: 人生的意义不在于寿命的长短，而在于活得有没有价值。
quiz.en: The meaning of life lies not in how long you live, but in whether you live a worthwhile life.

参展.gloss: to take part in an exhibition

example.zh: 今年有三百多家企业参展，比去年多了一倍。
example.en: More than three hundred companies are exhibiting this year, twice as many as last year.

quiz.zh: 他的油画被选中参展，这让他非常激动。
quiz.en: His oil painting was selected for the exhibition, which thrilled him.

example.zh: 人工智能正在改变我们的生活方式。
example.en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live.

quiz.zh: 现在很多客服电话都是由人工智能自动接听的。
quiz.en: Many customer service calls are now answered automatically by AI.

国情.gloss: national conditions, the situation of a country

example.zh: 每个国家都应该根据自己的国情选择发展道路。
example.en: Every country should choose its path of development based on its own national conditions.

quiz.zh: 外国企业想在中国发展，必须先了解中国的国情。
quiz.en: Foreign companies that want to grow in China must first understand the country's conditions.

example.zh: 她在世界锦标赛上获得了一枚铜牌。
example.en: She won a bronze medal at the world championships.

quiz.zh: 在三四名决赛中，他战胜了对手，获得了铜牌。
quiz.en: In the third-place match, he beat his opponent and took the bronze.

example.zh: 春节期间，各地都会举行丰富多彩的民俗活动。
example.en: During the Spring Festival, all kinds of colorful folk events are held around the country.

quiz.zh: 这个民俗博物馆展示了当地人的婚礼习俗和传统服装。
quiz.en: This folk museum displays local wedding customs and traditional clothing.

example.zh: 政府出台了一系列措施来鼓励创业。
example.en: The government has introduced a series of measures to encourage entrepreneurship.

quiz.zh: 搬到新城市后，他遇到了一系列问题，比如找房子、找工作。
quiz.en: After moving to a new city, he ran into a whole string of problems, like finding a place to live and finding a job.

文科.gloss: liberal arts, humanities (as a school track)

example.zh: 她对历史和文学很感兴趣，所以选了文科。
example.en: She's very interested in history and literature, so she chose the humanities track.

quiz.zh: 这所大学以文科见长，中文系和历史系尤其有名。
quiz.en: This university is strong in the liberal arts; its Chinese and history departments are especially well known.

example.zh: 部队官兵连夜赶往灾区抗洪救灾。
example.en: Soldiers rushed overnight to the disaster area to fight the floods and help victims.

quiz.zh: 地震发生后，政府立即拨出专款用于救灾。
quiz.en: After the earthquake, the government immediately allocated special funds for disaster relief.

升学.gloss: to go on to a higher school
升学.indonesian: melanjutkan ke jenjang sekolah yang lebih tinggi

example.zh: 现在的中学生升学压力很大。
example.en: Secondary school students today are under great pressure to get into the next level of school.

quiz.zh: 这所高中的升学率很高，几乎所有学生都考上了大学。
quiz.en: This high school has a very high progression rate; almost all its students get into university.

下旬.gloss: last ten days of a month, late in the month
下旬.indonesian: sepuluh hari terakhir bulan, akhir bulan

example.zh: 这次会议定在本月下旬召开。
example.en: The meeting is scheduled for the latter part of this month.

quiz.zh: 一般到了十一月下旬，北方就开始下雪了。
quiz.en: By late November it usually starts snowing in the north.

example.zh: 春天的西湖边游人如织，到处都是拍照的人。
example.en: In spring the shores of West Lake are thronged with visitors, with people taking photos everywhere.

quiz.zh: 节假日公园里游人很多，最好早点儿去。
quiz.en: The park is crowded with visitors on holidays, so it's best to go early.

炒股.gloss: to trade stocks, to speculate in stocks

example.zh: 他炒股赔了不少钱，现在再也不敢碰股票了。
example.en: He lost a lot of money trading stocks and doesn't dare touch them anymore.

quiz.zh: 最近股市行情好，连我妈都开始在手机上炒股了。
quiz.en: The stock market has been doing well lately; even my mom has started trading on her phone.

example.zh: 端午节的时候，中国人有吃粽子的习俗。
example.en: At the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people traditionally eat zongzi.

quiz.zh: 奶奶包的粽子里有红枣，又香又甜。
quiz.en: The zongzi Grandma makes have red dates inside; they're fragrant and sweet.

选修.gloss: to take as an elective; elective (course)
选修.indonesian: mengambil mata kuliah pilihan; pilihan (mata kuliah)

example.zh: 这学期我选修了一门日语课。
example.en: This semester I took a Japanese class as an elective.

quiz.zh: 这门课不是必修课，同学们可以根据兴趣自由选修。
quiz.en: This course isn't compulsory; students are free to take it as an elective if they're interested.

example.zh: 这瓶矿泉水是五百五十毫升的。
example.en: This bottle of mineral water holds 550 milliliters.

quiz.zh: 医生嘱咐他每次服用十毫升，一天三次。
quiz.en: The doctor told him to take ten milliliters at a time, three times a day.

example.zh: 为了举办奥运会，这座城市新建了很多体育场馆。
example.en: To host the Olympics, the city built many new sports venues.

quiz.zh: 比赛开始前一个小时，场馆里已经坐满了观众。
quiz.en: An hour before the match began, the venue was already packed with spectators.

example.zh: 外面打雷了，快把窗户关上，要下大雨了。
example.en: It's thundering outside; shut the windows, quick, a downpour is coming.

quiz.zh: 小时候我一听到打雷就害怕得钻到被子里。
quiz.en: As a child, whenever I heard thunder I'd get scared and hide under the covers.

example.zh: 看到老人上车，他赶忙站起来让座。
example.en: When he saw an elderly person get on, he quickly stood up to offer his seat.

quiz.zh: 听说孩子在学校受伤了，妈妈赶忙放下工作往学校跑。
quiz.en: Hearing that her child had been hurt at school, the mother dropped her work and hurried there.

example.zh: 这个网页打不开，你换个浏览器试试。
example.en: This page won't open; try a different browser.

quiz.zh: 为了安全，最好定期清理浏览器的历史记录。
quiz.en: For security, it's best to clear your browser history regularly.

example.zh: 南方的很多地区适合种植水稻。
example.en: Many areas in the south are well suited to growing rice.

quiz.zh: 秋天到了，田里的水稻一片金黄，农民们开始收割了。
quiz.en: Autumn has come; the rice in the fields has turned golden and the farmers have started harvesting.

example.zh: 她身材高挑，大学时就开始当模特儿了。
example.en: She's tall and slender and started modeling while in college.

quiz.zh: 服装发布会上，模特儿们穿着各式各样的时装走上了舞台。
quiz.en: At the fashion show, the models walked onto the stage in all kinds of outfits.

名胜.gloss: famous scenic spot, place of interest

example.zh: 杭州有很多名胜，最有名的是西湖。
example.en: Hangzhou has many famous sights, the best known being West Lake.

quiz.zh: 这座小城虽然没有什么名胜，但生活节奏很慢，很适合度假。
quiz.en: This small town doesn't have any famous sights, but life moves slowly there, which makes it great for a holiday.

好容易.gloss: with great difficulty; (finally) after much effort
好容易.indonesian: dengan susah payah; akhirnya (setelah berusaha keras)

example.zh: 我好容易才买到两张票，你可千万别迟到。
example.en: It was a real struggle to get two tickets, so whatever you do, don't be late.

quiz.zh: 找了半个小时，好容易才找到一个停车位。
quiz.en: After searching for half an hour, we finally managed to find a parking space.

工序.gloss: working procedure, step in a production process

example.zh: 做一双手工皮鞋需要经过几十道工序。
example.en: Making a pair of handmade leather shoes takes dozens of steps.

quiz.zh: 这道工序非常关键，稍有差错整个产品就报废了。
quiz.en: This step is crucial; the slightest mistake and the whole product has to be scrapped.

example.zh: 今年夏天发生了严重的旱灾，庄稼几乎没有收成。
example.en: There was a severe drought this summer, and the crops yielded almost nothing.

quiz.zh: 连续三个月没下雨，这个地区遭受了百年不遇的旱灾。
quiz.en: With no rain for three months in a row, the region was hit by its worst drought in a century.

千家万户.indonesian: ribuan keluarga, rumah-rumah yang tak terhitung

example.zh: 如今，智能手机已经走进了千家万户。
example.en: Today, smartphones have made their way into countless homes.

quiz.zh: 春节晚会通过电视传到千家万户，陪伴大家度过除夕。
quiz.en: The Spring Festival Gala reaches millions of households on TV, keeping everyone company on New Year's Eve.

example.zh: 这种牛奶在常温下可以保存六个月。
example.en: This milk keeps for six months at room temperature.

quiz.zh: 这种药需要冷藏，不能在常温下存放。
quiz.en: This medicine needs to be refrigerated; it can't be stored at room temperature.

家家户户.gloss: every household, each and every family

example.zh: 过年的时候，家家户户都贴春联、挂灯笼。
example.en: At New Year, every household puts up couplets and hangs lanterns.

quiz.zh: 一到傍晚，村子里家家户户的烟囱里都冒出了炊烟。
quiz.en: As evening falls, cooking smoke rises from the chimney of every home in the village.

高新技术.indonesian: teknologi tinggi dan baru, teknologi canggih

example.zh: 这个开发区吸引了一大批高新技术企业。
example.en: This development zone has attracted a large number of high-tech companies.

quiz.zh: 政府鼓励企业加大投入，发展高新技术产业。
quiz.en: The government encourages companies to invest more in developing high-tech industries.

衣食住行.gloss: clothing, food, housing and transport; the basic necessities of life
衣食住行.indonesian: sandang, pangan, papan, dan transportasi; kebutuhan pokok hidup

example.zh: 网络已经深入到人们衣食住行的各个方面。
example.en: The internet now reaches into every part of daily life: what people wear, eat, where they live and how they get around.

quiz.zh: 工作以后，我的衣食住行都要靠自己了，不能再依赖父母。
quiz.en: Now that I'm working, I have to provide my own food, clothing, housing and transport and can't rely on my parents anymore.

example.zh: 英语是大学一年级的必修课。
example.en: English is a required course in the first year of university.

quiz.zh: 这门课是本专业的必修课程，不及格就不能毕业。
quiz.en: This is a compulsory course for the major; if you fail it, you can't graduate.

上旬.gloss: first ten days of a month, early in the month
上旬.indonesian: sepuluh hari pertama bulan, awal bulan

example.zh: 新学期将于九月上旬开学，请同学们做好准备。
example.en: The new semester starts in early September; students, please get ready.

quiz.zh: 这批货物预计在下个月上旬到达。
quiz.en: This shipment is expected to arrive early next month.

看得起.gloss: to think highly of, to respect

example.zh: 只要你努力工作，别人自然会看得起你。
example.en: As long as you work hard, people will naturally respect you.

quiz.zh: 谢谢你这么看得起我，把这么重要的任务交给我。
quiz.en: Thank you for thinking so highly of me and trusting me with such an important task.

example.zh: 京剧是中国最有代表性的戏曲之一。
example.en: Peking opera is one of the most representative forms of traditional Chinese opera.

quiz.zh: 爷爷特别喜欢听戏曲，每天都打开收音机听上一段。
quiz.en: Grandpa loves traditional opera and turns on the radio every day to listen to a bit of it.

example.zh: 这位作家的作品在海内外都很受欢迎。
example.en: This writer's works are popular both at home and abroad.

quiz.zh: 这次纪念活动吸引了海内外数千名华人参加。
quiz.en: The commemoration drew thousands of Chinese people from home and abroad.

example.zh: 这座城市文化多元，生活着来自世界各地的人。
example.en: This city is culturally diverse, home to people from all over the world.

quiz.zh: 随着社会的发展，年轻人的价值观越来越多元了。
quiz.en: As society develops, young people's values are becoming more and more diverse.

example.zh: 他勤奋好学，每天都是最后一个离开图书馆的。
example.en: He's hardworking and eager to learn, and he's the last to leave the library every day.

quiz.zh: 她从小聪明好学，学习成绩一直名列前茅。
quiz.en: She's been bright and studious since childhood and has always been at the top of her class.

汤圆.gloss: tangyuan (glutinous rice balls served in soup)

example.zh: 元宵节的时候，南方人习惯吃汤圆。
example.en: At the Lantern Festival, people in the south usually eat tangyuan.

quiz.zh: 妈妈煮了一锅芝麻馅儿的汤圆，大家吃得很香。
quiz.en: Mom cooked a pot of sesame-filled tangyuan, and everyone ate them with relish.

example.zh: 这个国家已经普及了初等教育。
example.en: This country has achieved universal primary education.

quiz.zh: 这本书只讲初等数学，高中生完全看得懂。
quiz.en: This book only covers elementary mathematics, so high school students can follow it easily.

example.zh: 把米洗好放进电饭锅，半个小时饭就熟了。
example.en: Wash the rice and put it in the rice cooker; it'll be done in half an hour.

quiz.zh: 这个电饭锅有预约功能，早上起床就能吃到热粥。
quiz.en: This rice cooker has a delay timer, so there's hot porridge ready when you get up.

example.zh: 在拥挤的公交车上要小心小偷儿。
example.en: Watch out for pickpockets on crowded buses.

quiz.zh: 警察很快就抓住了那个偷钱包的小偷儿。
quiz.en: The police quickly caught the thief who stole the wallet.

example.zh: 骑自行车上班是一种低碳的生活方式。
example.en: Cycling to work is a low-carbon way of living.

quiz.zh: 为了保护环境，我们应该提倡低碳出行，少开私家车。
quiz.en: To protect the environment, we should promote low-carbon travel and drive our own cars less.

example.zh: 看电影的时候，他喜欢一边吃薯片一边喝可乐。
example.en: When watching movies, he likes to eat potato chips and drink cola.

quiz.zh: 薯片好吃是好吃，但热量太高，不能多吃。
quiz.en: Chips are tasty, sure, but they're high in calories, so don't eat too many.

性价比.indonesian: rasio harga dan kualitas, sepadan dengan harganya

example.zh: 这款手机价格不贵，性能也不错，性价比很高。
example.en: This phone isn't expensive and performs well; it's great value for money.

quiz.zh: 买东西不能只看价格，还要看性价比。
quiz.en: When shopping, you shouldn't look only at the price but also at the value for money.

example.zh: 美国和加拿大都位于北美洲。
example.en: The United States and Canada are both in North America.

quiz.zh: 这家公司的产品主要出口到欧洲和北美洲。
quiz.en: This company mainly exports its products to Europe and North America.

倍增.gloss: to double; to multiply, to increase greatly

example.zh: 这项新技术让工厂的产量倍增。
example.en: This new technology has doubled the factory's output.

quiz.zh: 听了大家的鼓励，他信心倍增，决定再试一次。
quiz.en: Everyone's encouragement greatly boosted his confidence, and he decided to try again.

example.zh: 考试期间，考场内不得使用手机等电子设备。
example.en: During the exam, phones and other electronic devices may not be used in the exam room.

quiz.zh: 未经允许，任何人不得进入实验室。
quiz.en: No one may enter the lab without permission.

材质.gloss: material (an object is made of), texture

example.zh: 这件衬衫的材质是纯棉的，穿着很舒服。
example.en: This shirt is made of pure cotton and is very comfortable to wear.

quiz.zh: 这两个包看起来差不多，但材质不同，价格相差很大。
quiz.en: These two bags look about the same, but they're made of different materials, so their prices are very different.

example.zh: 这块地每年能产出两千斤粮食。
example.en: This plot of land can produce two thousand jin of grain a year.

quiz.zh: 企业要想办法提高投入产出比，降低成本。
quiz.en: Companies need to find ways to improve their input-output ratio and lower costs.

场次.gloss: number of shows or sessions; a screening or performance (time slot)
场次.indonesian: jumlah pertunjukan; jadwal tayang atau sesi

example.zh: 这部电影很火，影院增加了放映场次。
example.en: This film is a big hit, so the cinema has added more screenings.

quiz.zh: 今晚八点的场次已经满了，只剩下十点的票了。
quiz.en: Tonight's 8 o'clock show is sold out; there are only tickets left for 10.

撤回.gloss: to withdraw, to retract; to recall (a message)

example.zh: 他发现消息发错了人，赶紧撤回了。
example.en: He realized he'd sent the message to the wrong person and quickly unsent it.

quiz.zh: 由于受到很多批评，公司撤回了这项新规定。
quiz.en: After a lot of criticism, the company withdrew the new rule.

出力.gloss: to exert oneself, to contribute effort

example.zh: 大家有钱的出钱，有力的出力，很快就把路修好了。
example.en: Those with money gave money and those with strength gave labor, and the road was soon repaired.

quiz.zh: 他总想为家乡的发展出力，所以大学毕业后回到了老家。
quiz.en: He always wanted to contribute to his hometown's development, so he went back after graduating.

窗口.gloss: service window, counter; window (on a computer screen)

example.zh: 请到三号窗口办理退票手续。
example.en: Please go to window number three to get a refund on your ticket.

quiz.zh: 电脑屏幕上突然弹出一个广告窗口，怎么也关不掉。
quiz.en: An ad window suddenly popped up on the computer screen and wouldn't close no matter what I did.

example.zh: 这个硬盘可以存储上万张照片。
example.en: This hard drive can store tens of thousands of photos.

quiz.zh: 这些重要文件最好存储在云端，以防电脑坏了丢失。
quiz.en: It's best to store these important files in the cloud in case your computer breaks and they get lost.

打卡.gloss: to clock in; to check in (at a place, on social media)
打卡.indonesian: absen masuk (kerja); check-in (di suatu tempat, media sosial)

example.zh: 公司规定每天早上九点前必须打卡。
example.en: Company rules say you must clock in before nine every morning.

quiz.zh: 这家网红咖啡店每天都有很多年轻人来拍照打卡。
quiz.en: Every day, lots of young people come to this trendy café to take photos and check in.

example.zh: 今年公司的利润大幅增长，员工们都拿到了奖金。
example.en: The company's profits rose sharply this year, and all the employees got a bonus.

quiz.zh: 受天气影响，蔬菜价格大幅上涨。
quiz.en: Because of the weather, vegetable prices have shot up.

example.zh: 澳大利亚是大洋洲面积最大的国家。
example.en: Australia is the largest country in Oceania.

quiz.zh: 这次旅行我们去了大洋洲，参观了新西兰的好几个城市。
quiz.en: On this trip we went to Oceania and visited several cities in New Zealand.

点击.gloss: to click; clicks, hits (on a website)

example.zh: 点击这个按钮，就可以下载文件了。
example.en: Click this button and you can download the file.

quiz.zh: 这段视频发布后，点击量很快就超过了一百万。
quiz.en: After the video was posted, its view count quickly passed one million.

example.zh: 这条街上的店铺大多卖手工艺品。
example.en: Most of the shops on this street sell handicrafts.

quiz.zh: 他在网上开了一家店铺，专门卖家乡的特产。
quiz.en: He opened an online shop that sells specialty products from his hometown.

example.zh: 这套西服是我在裁缝店定制的，特别合身。
example.en: I had this suit made to measure at a tailor's, and it fits perfectly.

quiz.zh: 旅行社可以根据客人的需求定制旅游路线。
quiz.en: The travel agency can tailor itineraries to what customers want.

example.zh: 很多年轻人是日本动漫的忠实粉丝。
example.en: Many young people are devoted fans of Japanese anime.

quiz.zh: 这部国产动漫在网上播出后，人气一下子就上来了。
quiz.en: Once this Chinese animated series aired online, its popularity shot up overnight.

对接.gloss: to dock; to link up, to coordinate (with)
对接.indonesian: berlabuh (pesawat antariksa); menjalin kerja sama, menghubungkan

example.zh: 两艘飞船在太空中成功对接。
example.en: The two spacecraft successfully docked in space.

quiz.zh: 学校积极与企业对接，帮助毕业生找到工作。
quiz.en: The school actively partners with companies to help graduates find jobs.

多才多艺.indonesian: serba bisa, berbakat di banyak bidang

example.zh: 她多才多艺，既会弹钢琴，又会画画。
example.en: She's multi-talented: she plays the piano and paints as well.

quiz.zh: 我们班的班长唱歌、跳舞、写文章样样都行，真是多才多艺。
quiz.en: Our class monitor can sing, dance and write; she's truly versatile.

example.zh: 春节是中国的法定节假日，一般放假七天。
example.en: The Spring Festival is a statutory holiday in China, usually with seven days off.

quiz.zh: 在中国，男性的法定结婚年龄是二十二岁。
quiz.en: In China, the legal marriage age for men is twenty-two.

放飞.gloss: to release (a bird, kite) into the air; to set free

example.zh: 春天到了，孩子们在广场上放飞风筝。
example.en: Spring is here, and children are flying kites in the square.

quiz.zh: 等小鸟的伤养好了，我们就把它放飞了。
quiz.en: Once the little bird's injury healed, we released it.

example.zh: 他感冒一直没好，后来发展成了肺炎。
example.en: His cold never got better and later turned into pneumonia.

quiz.zh: 医生说老人得的是肺炎，需要住院治疗。
quiz.en: The doctor said the old man has pneumonia and needs to be treated in hospital.

分级.gloss: to classify, to grade, to divide into levels

example.zh: 这家超市把鸡蛋按大小分级出售。
example.en: This supermarket sorts eggs into grades by size before selling them.

quiz.zh: 很多国家对电影实行分级制度，有些电影不适合儿童观看。
quiz.en: Many countries have a rating system for films, and some films aren't suitable for children.

分期.gloss: by stages; to pay in installments

example.zh: 这台电脑可以分期付款，每月只要三百元。
example.en: You can pay for this computer in installments, just three hundred yuan a month.

quiz.zh: 这笔钱我一下子拿不出来，能不能分期还给你？
quiz.en: I can't come up with this money all at once; can I pay you back in installments?

example.zh: 上海港是世界上最繁忙的港口之一，每天都有大量货船进出。
example.en: The port of Shanghai is one of the busiest in the world, with large numbers of cargo ships coming and going every day.

quiz.zh: 船慢慢驶进了港口，岸上的人们向船上招手。
quiz.en: The ship slowly sailed into the harbor as people on shore waved to it.

高端.indonesian: kelas atas, tingkat tinggi; produk premium

example.zh: 这家商场主要销售高端品牌的服装。
example.en: This mall mainly sells clothes from high-end brands.

quiz.zh: 公司决定进军高端市场，推出价格更贵、质量更好的产品。
quiz.en: The company decided to move into the high-end market, launching pricier, higher-quality products.

寒冬.gloss: severe winter, the depths of winter

example.zh: 在寒冬腊月里，河面结了厚厚的一层冰。
example.en: In the depths of winter, the river is covered with a thick layer of ice.

quiz.zh: 这些流浪猫没有地方住，很难熬过这个寒冬。
quiz.en: These stray cats have nowhere to live and will struggle to make it through this harsh winter.

好不.gloss: how very, so (exclamatory, before an adjective)

example.zh: 节日的广场上张灯结彩，好不热闹。
example.en: The square is decked out with lanterns and streamers for the festival; how lively it is!

quiz.zh: 他穿上新军装，骑着高头大马，好不威风。
quiz.en: In his new uniform, riding a tall horse, he looked so impressive.

example.zh: 春天来了，公园里的花朵竞相开放。
example.en: Spring has come, and the flowers in the park are all bursting into bloom.

quiz.zh: 孩子们是祖国的花朵，需要我们好好爱护。
quiz.en: Children are the flowers of the nation and need our loving care.

滑行.gloss: to slide, to glide; (of a plane) to taxi

example.zh: 飞机在跑道上滑行了一段距离后起飞了。
example.en: The plane rolled down the runway for a while and then took off.

quiz.zh: 他穿上冰鞋，在冰面上轻快地滑行。
quiz.en: He put on his skates and glided lightly across the ice.

怀.gloss: bosom, arms (embrace); to keep in mind, to cherish

example.zh: 孩子扑进妈妈的怀里哭了起来。
example.en: The child threw himself into his mother's arms and started to cry.

quiz.zh: 她心怀感激地说：“没有你们的帮助，就没有今天的我。”
quiz.en: Full of gratitude, she said, "Without your help, I wouldn't be where I am today."

example.zh: 中国女排三比一击败对手，获得了冠军。
example.en: The Chinese women's volleyball team beat their opponents 3–1 and won the title.

quiz.zh: 在总决赛中，这位年轻选手击败了上届冠军，令人吃惊。
quiz.en: In the final, this young player stunned everyone by defeating the defending champion.

加倍.gloss: to double; doubly, all the more

example.zh: 如果不按时还款，罚款将会加倍。
example.en: If you don't repay on time, the fine will be doubled.

quiz.zh: 上次考试没考好，这次他加倍努力，终于考了第一名。
quiz.en: He did badly on the last exam, so this time he worked twice as hard and finally came first.

家居.indonesian: rumah tangga; perabot dan dekorasi rumah

example.zh: 这个家居商场的家具款式很多，价格也不贵。
example.en: This home furnishings store has lots of furniture styles, and the prices aren't high.

quiz.zh: 这本杂志专门介绍家居装饰，教人怎么布置房间。
quiz.en: This magazine is all about home decor and shows you how to arrange your rooms.

example.zh: 今天的考试题目较为简单，大部分同学都答完了。
example.en: Today's exam questions were fairly easy, and most students finished them.

quiz.zh: 这个地区交通较为方便，适合开工厂。
quiz.en: Transport in this area is relatively convenient, which makes it suitable for building factories.

example.zh: 现在的天气预报越来越精准，连几点下雨都能预测。
example.en: Weather forecasts are increasingly precise these days; they can even predict what time it will rain.

quiz.zh: 他的射门又快又精准，守门员根本来不及反应。
quiz.en: His shot was fast and precise, and the goalkeeper had no time to react.

example.zh: 妈妈做的饭菜总是那么可口。
example.en: The food Mom makes is always so delicious.

quiz.zh: 这家餐厅的菜清淡可口，很受老年人欢迎。
quiz.en: This restaurant's dishes are light and tasty, and they're very popular with older people.

example.zh: 这种面包口感很软，孩子们都爱吃。
example.en: This bread is soft to the bite, and kids love it.

quiz.zh: 这款酸奶加了水果粒，口感更丰富了。
quiz.en: This yogurt has added fruit pieces, giving it a richer texture.

example.zh: 运动会上，同学们大声喊着班级的口号。
example.en: At the sports meet, the students loudly shouted their class slogan.

quiz.zh: 环保不能只喊口号，要从身边的小事做起。
quiz.en: Protecting the environment isn't just about shouting slogans; it starts with little things in daily life.

example.zh: 饭后要及时漱口，保持口腔清洁。
example.en: Rinse your mouth promptly after meals to keep it clean.

quiz.zh: 牙疼了好几天，他终于去口腔医院看了医生。
quiz.en: After several days of toothache, he finally went to a dental hospital to see a doctor.

款.gloss: sum of money, fund; measure word for styles or models (of products)
款.indonesian: sejumlah uang, dana; kata penggolong untuk model atau jenis produk

example.zh: 这两款手机外观差不多，但价格差了一千块。
example.en: These two phone models look about the same, but their prices differ by a thousand yuan.

quiz.zh: 这款背包又轻又结实，最近卖得特别好。
quiz.en: This backpack is light and sturdy, and it's been selling really well lately.

example.zh: 爷爷在阳台上养了好几盆兰花。
example.en: Grandpa grows several pots of orchids on the balcony.

quiz.zh: 这盆兰花开出了淡紫色的花，屋子里满是清香。
quiz.en: This orchid has put out pale purple flowers, and the room is filled with a delicate fragrance.

乐于.gloss: to be happy to, to take pleasure in

example.zh: 他乐于助人，邻居们都很喜欢他。
example.en: He's always happy to help others, and all the neighbors like him.

quiz.zh: 年轻人更乐于接受新鲜事物。
quiz.en: Young people are more willing to embrace new things.

历年.indonesian: tahun-tahun sebelumnya, dari tahun ke tahun

example.zh: 复习时多做做历年的考试真题很有帮助。
example.en: When reviewing, it really helps to work through past years' exam papers.

quiz.zh: 今年的报名人数创下了历年最高纪录。
quiz.en: This year's number of applicants was the highest of any year on record.

example.zh: 我把文章的链接发给你了，你点开看看。
example.en: I've sent you the link to the article; open it and take a look.

quiz.zh: 不要随便点陌生人发来的链接，小心被骗。
quiz.en: Don't click on links from strangers carelessly; watch out for scams.

两极.gloss: the two poles (of the earth); two extremes

example.zh: 地球的两极常年被冰雪覆盖。
example.en: The Earth's two poles are covered with ice and snow all year round.

quiz.zh: 观众对这部电影的评价出现了两极分化，有人很喜欢，有人很讨厌。
quiz.en: Audience opinion on this film is polarized: some love it, others hate it.

录用.gloss: to hire, to take on (an applicant)

example.zh: 经过三轮面试，他终于被这家公司录用了。
example.en: After three rounds of interviews, he was finally hired by the company.

quiz.zh: 很遗憾，您没有被录用，欢迎下次再来应聘。
quiz.en: We regret to inform you that you were not selected; you're welcome to apply again in the future.

免税.gloss: tax-free, duty-free; to exempt from tax

example.zh: 在机场的免税店买化妆品比较便宜。
example.en: Cosmetics are cheaper at the airport duty-free shop.

quiz.zh: 这类小企业可以享受免税政策。
quiz.en: Small businesses of this kind qualify for tax exemption.

example.zh: 我们在古镇住了一家民宿，老板特别热情。
example.en: We stayed at a guesthouse in the old town, and the owner was really friendly.

quiz.zh: 这几年乡村旅游火了，村里很多人把自家的房子改成了民宿。
quiz.en: Rural tourism has taken off in recent years, and many villagers have turned their houses into homestays.

example.zh: 南极洲是世界上最冷的大陆。
example.en: Antarctica is the coldest continent in the world.

quiz.zh: 企鹅主要生活在南极洲及其附近的海域。
quiz.en: Penguins live mainly in Antarctica and the surrounding seas.

example.zh: 巴西是南美洲面积最大的国家。
example.en: Brazil is the largest country in South America.

quiz.zh: 亚马孙河流经南美洲的好几个国家。
quiz.en: The Amazon River flows through several countries in South America.

example.zh: 大片的农田被改建成了工厂和住宅。
example.en: Large stretches of farmland have been turned into factories and housing.

quiz.zh: 一场大雨过后，农田里的庄稼长得更旺了。
quiz.en: After a heavy rain, the crops in the fields grew even more vigorously.

扑灭.gloss: to put out, to extinguish; to stamp out

example.zh: 消防员花了两个小时才把大火扑灭。
example.en: It took firefighters two hours to put out the blaze.

quiz.zh: 森林大火终于被扑灭了，但损失十分严重。
quiz.en: The forest fire was finally extinguished, but the damage was severe.

example.zh: 下雪后，环卫工人一大早就开始清扫街道。
example.en: After the snowfall, sanitation workers started clearing the streets first thing in the morning.

quiz.zh: 过年前，家家户户都要把屋子彻底清扫一遍。
quiz.en: Before New Year, every family gives their home a thorough cleaning.

热度.gloss: degree of heat; popularity, (level of) public interest
热度.indonesian: tingkat panas; popularitas, tingkat perhatian publik

example.zh: 这个话题在网上的热度一直很高。
example.en: This topic has been getting a lot of attention online.

quiz.zh: 他对学画画只有三分钟热度，没几天就放弃了。
quiz.en: His enthusiasm for painting was short-lived; he gave up after a few days.

热议.gloss: to hotly discuss; heated public discussion

example.zh: 这条新闻一发布，就引发了网友的热议。
example.en: As soon as the news came out, it set off heated discussion among netizens.

quiz.zh: 这部电视剧大结局播出后，观众们纷纷在网上热议。
quiz.en: After the finale of the series aired, viewers flocked online to debate it.

人山人海.gloss: huge crowds of people, a sea of people

example.zh: 国庆期间，各大景点都是人山人海。
example.en: During the National Day holiday, all the major tourist spots are packed with people.

quiz.zh: 演唱会还没开始，体育场外面已经人山人海了。
quiz.en: The concert hadn't even started, but there was already a sea of people outside the stadium.

example.zh: 这个周末电视台将直播多场足球赛事。
example.en: This weekend the TV station will broadcast several football matches live.

quiz.zh: 这座城市每年都要举办好几项国际体育赛事。
quiz.en: This city hosts several international sporting events every year.

example.zh: 伤口还没长好，千万不要沾水。
example.en: The wound hasn't healed yet, so don't get it wet.

quiz.zh: 他切菜时不小心切到了手指，伤口流了很多血。
quiz.en: He accidentally cut his finger while chopping vegetables, and the cut bled a lot.

example.zh: 路口装了摄像头，闯红灯会被拍下来。
example.en: There's a camera at the intersection, so running a red light will get you photographed.

quiz.zh: 开视频会议之前，记得检查一下电脑的摄像头能不能用。
quiz.en: Before a video meeting, remember to check that your computer's camera works.

example.zh: 这棵小树从石头缝里长出来，生命力真顽强。
example.en: This little tree grew out of a crack in the rock; it's incredibly resilient.

quiz.zh: 传统文化只有不断创新，才能保持旺盛的生命力。
quiz.en: Traditional culture can only stay vibrant by constantly innovating.

example.zh: 她从小就喜欢背古代诗词，能背好几百首。
example.en: She has loved memorizing classical poetry since she was little and can recite several hundred poems.

quiz.zh: 这档节目以比赛的形式让观众感受中国古典诗词的魅力。
quiz.en: This show uses a competition format to let viewers experience the charm of classical Chinese poetry.

example.zh: 这个软件可以实时显示公交车的位置。
example.en: This app shows the location of buses in real time.

quiz.zh: 比赛的比分会在大屏幕上实时更新。
quiz.en: The score is updated live on the big screen.

example.zh: 这次书画展展出了一百多幅作品。
example.en: Over a hundred works are on display at this calligraphy and painting exhibition.

quiz.zh: 退休以后，王老师开始学习书画，现在已经小有名气了。
quiz.en: After retiring, Mr. Wang took up calligraphy and painting, and now he's become fairly well known.

example.zh: 图书馆正在把古籍数字化，方便读者在网上查阅。
example.en: The library is digitizing its ancient books so readers can consult them online.

quiz.zh: 随着数字化程度提高，现在去银行办业务的人越来越少了。
quiz.en: As things become more digital, fewer and fewer people go to the bank in person.

example.zh: 这段河道水流很急，禁止游泳。
example.en: The current in this stretch of the river is very swift; swimming is prohibited.

quiz.zh: 打开水龙头，水流很小，可能是水压不够。
quiz.en: When I turn on the tap, only a trickle comes out; maybe the water pressure is too low.

提取.gloss: to extract; to withdraw, to retrieve

example.zh: 科学家从这种植物中提取出了一种新药。
example.en: Scientists extracted a new drug from this plant.

quiz.zh: 警方在现场提取到了嫌疑人的指纹。
quiz.en: The police lifted the suspect's fingerprints at the scene.

example.zh: 狗的听觉比人灵敏得多，很远的声音都能听见。
example.en: Dogs' hearing is much sharper than ours; they can hear sounds from far away.

quiz.zh: 长期戴着耳机听大声的音乐，会损伤听觉。
quiz.en: Listening to loud music through headphones for long periods can damage your hearing.

example.zh: 外国游客在这家商场购物可以办理退税。
example.en: Foreign tourists who shop at this mall can claim a tax refund.

quiz.zh: 政府为出口企业退税，减轻了它们的负担。
quiz.en: The government gives tax rebates to exporters, easing their burden.

example.zh: 我外甥今年上小学一年级了。
example.en: My nephew started first grade this year.

quiz.zh: 姐姐的儿子是我的外甥，他特别喜欢跟我玩。
quiz.en: My older sister's son is my nephew, and he loves playing with me.

万物.gloss: all things, everything in the universe

example.zh: 春天来了，万物复苏，到处都是一片生机。
example.en: Spring has come; all of nature is reviving, and everything is full of life.

quiz.zh: 太阳是地球上万物生长的能量来源。
quiz.en: The sun is the source of energy for all living things on Earth.

example.zh: 这种细菌非常微小，只能用显微镜才能看到。
example.en: These bacteria are so tiny that you can only see them with a microscope.

quiz.zh: 哪怕是一个微小的进步，也值得表扬。
quiz.en: Even a tiny bit of progress deserves praise.

example.zh: 他从五岁开始学下围棋，十岁就拿了全国冠军。
example.en: He started learning Go at five and won the national championship at ten.

quiz.zh: 人工智能在围棋比赛中战胜了世界冠军。
quiz.en: An AI defeated the world champion in a Go match.

example.zh: 感冒的时候，人的味觉会变得迟钝。
example.en: When you have a cold, your sense of taste becomes dull.

quiz.zh: 这道菜酸甜辣咸样样俱全，给人带来丰富的味觉享受。
quiz.en: This dish is sour, sweet, spicy and salty all at once, a real treat for the taste buds.

example.zh: 他最近胃口不好，吃什么都不香。
example.en: He hasn't had much appetite lately; nothing tastes good to him.

quiz.zh: 这部电影很合我的胃口，我已经看了三遍了。
quiz.en: This film is right up my alley; I've already seen it three times.

example.zh: 请把会议记录整理成文档发到群里。
example.en: Please put the meeting notes into a document and post it in the group chat.

quiz.zh: 电脑突然死机，我还没来得及保存文档。
quiz.en: The computer suddenly froze before I had a chance to save the document.

example.zh: 乌龟爬得很慢，但能活很长时间。
example.en: Tortoises crawl slowly but can live a very long time.

quiz.zh: 儿子养了一只小乌龟，每天都给它喂吃的。
quiz.en: My son keeps a little turtle and feeds it every day.

洗漱.gloss: to wash up (wash face and brush teeth)

example.zh: 他每天早上六点起床，洗漱完就去跑步。
example.en: He gets up at six every morning, washes up and goes for a run.

quiz.zh: 出门旅行要带好洗漱用品，比如牙刷、毛巾。
quiz.en: When you travel, remember to bring toiletries such as a toothbrush and towel.

example.zh: 我昨晚在网上下单，今天上午就收到货了。
example.en: I placed the order online last night and got the package this morning.

quiz.zh: 这件衣服很多人在抢，再不下单就卖完了。
quiz.en: Lots of people are snapping up this item; if you don't order now, it'll sell out.

下线.gloss: to go offline, to log off; to be taken offline (of a service)

example.zh: 我有点儿事，先下线了，咱们明天再聊吧。
example.en: I've got something to do, so I'm logging off; let's talk tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 这款游戏因为用户太少，下个月将正式下线。
quiz.en: Because it has too few players, this game will be officially shut down next month.

现存.gloss: extant, still in existence, currently existing
现存.indonesian: yang masih ada, yang tersisa sekarang

example.zh: 这是我国现存最古老的木结构建筑。
example.en: This is the oldest surviving wooden building in our country.

quiz.zh: 据统计，野外现存的大熊猫有一千八百多只。
quiz.en: According to statistics, there are just over 1,800 giant pandas left in the wild.

example.zh: 这款沙发有现货，今天下单明天就能送到。
example.en: This sofa is in stock; order today and it can be delivered tomorrow.

quiz.zh: 这本书暂时没有现货，需要预订，大概两周后到。
quiz.en: This book is currently out of stock and must be pre-ordered; it should arrive in about two weeks.

example.zh: 我从心底里感谢你这些年对我的帮助。
example.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart for all your help over the years.

quiz.zh: 这段往事一直埋在她的心底，从来没跟别人说过。
quiz.en: She has kept this part of her past buried deep in her heart and never told anyone.

example.zh: 很多年轻人通过新媒体获取新闻。
example.en: Many young people get their news through new media.

quiz.zh: 她在一家公司做新媒体运营，负责管理公众号和短视频账号。
quiz.en: She works in new media operations at a company, managing its official accounts and short-video channels.

example.zh: 现在路上的新能源汽车越来越多了。
example.en: There are more and more new-energy vehicles on the road these days.

quiz.zh: 太阳能、风能等新能源的发展，有助于减少环境污染。
quiz.en: Developing new energy sources such as solar and wind power helps reduce pollution.

example.zh: 天太热了，他把袖子卷了起来。
example.en: It was so hot that he rolled up his sleeves.

quiz.zh: 这件衬衫的袖子有点儿长，要拿去改一改。
quiz.en: The sleeves on this shirt are a bit long, so I need to get them altered.

example.zh: 输血之前，医生要先检查病人的血型。
example.en: Before a transfusion, the doctor must first check the patient's blood type.

quiz.zh: 献血的时候，护士问我知不知道自己是什么血型。
quiz.en: When I gave blood, the nurse asked if I knew my blood type.

一口气.gloss: in one breath; without a break, at one go
一口气.indonesian: dalam satu tarikan napas; tanpa berhenti, sekaligus

example.zh: 他一口气跑上了十楼，累得直喘气。
example.en: He ran up to the tenth floor without stopping and was left completely out of breath.

quiz.zh: 这本小说太好看了，我一口气就读完了。
quiz.en: This novel was so good that I read it in one sitting.

example.zh: 这种材料轻便耐用，而且易于清洗。
example.en: This material is light, durable and easy to clean.

quiz.zh: 老师讲课生动有趣，内容也易于理解。
quiz.en: The teacher's lectures are lively and interesting, and the content is easy to understand.

example.zh: 这小伙子真有劲，一个人就把冰箱搬上了楼。
example.en: That young guy is really strong; he carried the fridge upstairs all by himself.

quiz.zh: 睡了一个好觉，第二天干活儿特别有劲。
quiz.en: After a good night's sleep, I had loads of energy for work the next day.

元宵.gloss: yuanxiao (sweet rice-flour dumplings); Lantern Festival food
元宵.indonesian: yuanxiao (bola tepung ketan manis); makanan Festival Lampion

example.zh: 正月十五，北方人有吃元宵的习俗。
example.en: On the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, people in the north traditionally eat yuanxiao.

quiz.zh: 超市里摆满了各种口味的元宵，有黑芝麻的，还有山楂的。
quiz.en: The supermarket is full of yuanxiao in all sorts of flavors, from black sesame to hawthorn.

example.zh: 月光照在平静的湖面上，像撒了一层碎银子。
example.en: The moonlight on the calm lake looked like a scattering of silver.

quiz.zh: 夜深了，皎洁的月光从窗户照进来。
quiz.en: It was late at night, and bright moonlight shone in through the window.

example.zh: 老年人在这个城市人口中的占比越来越高。
example.en: The share of elderly people in this city's population keeps rising.

quiz.zh: 网购在居民消费中的占比已经超过了三成。
quiz.en: Online shopping now accounts for more than 30% of household spending.

example.zh: 天气预报说今天下午有阵雨，出门记得带伞。
example.en: The forecast says there will be showers this afternoon, so remember your umbrella.

quiz.zh: 夏天的阵雨来得快，去得也快，一会儿太阳又出来了。
quiz.en: Summer showers come and go quickly; the sun was out again in no time.

种地.gloss: to farm, to till the land

example.zh: 他年轻的时候在老家种地，后来到城里开了家饭馆。
example.en: When he was young he farmed back home, and later he opened a restaurant in the city.

quiz.zh: 现在种地也用上了无人机，农民轻松了不少。
quiz.en: Farming now uses drones too, which makes life a lot easier for farmers.

example.zh: 天气太热，有好几个工人中暑了。
example.en: It was so hot that several workers got heatstroke.

quiz.zh: 夏天在太阳底下待太久容易中暑，要多喝水。
quiz.en: In summer, staying in the sun too long can give you heatstroke, so drink plenty of water.

主播.gloss: (live-stream) host, news anchor; to host a broadcast
主播.indonesian: pembawa acara siaran langsung, penyiar berita; menyiarkan

example.zh: 她是一名带货主播，每天晚上直播卖东西。
example.en: She's a sales streamer who sells products on live broadcasts every night.

quiz.zh: 这位新闻主播声音好听，说话又清楚，观众都很喜欢她。
quiz.en: This news anchor has a pleasant voice and speaks clearly; viewers love her.

example.zh: 他非常自律，每天坚持早起读书、锻炼。
example.en: He's very self-disciplined, getting up early every day to read and exercise.

quiz.zh: 成功的人往往都很自律，能管住自己。
quiz.en: Successful people tend to be very self-disciplined and able to keep themselves in check.
